_help: League settings for The Gridiron Gazette. league_id and my_team come from your ESPN team page link (leagueId=..., teamId=...). Set name to override the ESPN league name on the site. To show owners' names, either set show_owner_first_names to true or list them in owners by team id, e.g. {"3": "Josh"}. live_issues: true also publishes the week in progress (Sunday's games in, Monday night still to play) whenever the update runs before the week ends; false waits for the final results.
